name: 32950-fixed1k1k-dsv2lite-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node (`--gres=gpu:1`).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism; one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU, ~31 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 4 streams, bounded at 120 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, 10% warmup, 5% cooldown.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain`, greedy; exactly 1000 prompt tokens and exactly 1000 output tokens, freshly sampled per request.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on one GPU, serving four concurrent users thousand-token prompts and thousand-token replies.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Anything not listed here is this commit's own default.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# What this engine's MLA selector resolves to anyway on SM90 under an fp8 KV cache;
# stated so that a later selector change cannot silently re-point the item.
attention-backend: FLASHMLA

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# The workload's worst case is 1000 prompt + 1000 output tokens; 4096 is the
# checkpoint's own `original_max_position_embeddings`. Yarn scaling still applies.
max-model-len: 4096
